items.title: Newmont (NEM) Drew A New Stake From Stanley Druckenmiller’s Family Office
items.summary: Newmont (NYSE:NEM) drew fresh attention after Stanley Druckenmiller’s family office took a sizeable new position in the gold miner. The family office also built positions in other large gold producers while trimming exposure to industrial metals and semiconductor stocks. The allocation shift by a high profile investor highlights growing institutional interest in gold mining equities as part of broader portfolio rebalancing.
